details.description: Straight from the heart of the Nilgiris forests, this wild honey is sourced from Apis Dorsata bees that gather nectar from a variety of forest flowers. It is pure, raw, and untouched. Shaped by seasonal blooms and bee foraging patterns, each jar offers a unique taste and aroma. Unprocessed and 100% natural, it brings you the purest taste of the wild.

Akshayakalpa Pollen Honey is sourced from the lush forests of the Nilgiris. Unlike regular honey, it is unfiltered and enriched with pollen, giving it a richer texture and extra nourishment. With its unique taste and high pollen content, it is more than just a sweetener. It is believed to boost immunity and support overall health.

Sourced from the black jamun flower bloom in the Nilgiris, this honey is a rare and special find. Unprocessed and free from additives, it delivers the pure taste of the Nilgiris in every spoonful. With its unique bittersweet flavour, jamun honey is not only a treat for your taste buds, but is also believed to offer the benefits of jamun, including helping to regulate blood sugar levels.
